source_title: Care of adults with neurofibromatosis type 1: a clinical practice resource of the American College of Medical Genetics and Genomics (ACMG)
claim_text: 18F-FDG-PET and PET/CT diagnosed NF1-associated MPNST with a sensitivity of 0.89 and a specificity of 0.95 in 116 lesions (59 histologically confirmed) from 105 NF1 patients.
notes: Full text from locally supplied PDF (Genet Med 2018;20:671-682; not in PMC). Statement made by the ACMG adult NF1 practice resource citing ref 26 Ferner 2008 PMID 17932395. Secondary citation: not independent of the cited primary work; primary paper should be read for strength grading.
independence_flags: secondary citation via guideline PMID 30006586 of ref 26
